dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in El Geneina Deparment, West Darfur State, Sudan as of 25 September 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240924SDN** This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent in El Geneina Department, West Darfur State, Sudan as observed from a Pléiades image acquired on 25 September 2024 at 11:46 local time. Within the cloud free analysed area of about 20,000ha, a total of about 8050ha of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
